status: Local candidate; implementation authorized, release approval required
source: Two retained historical client-observed Campaign positions, inspected and copied separately under .wrangler/testing-0.213-2026-11-06/real-campaign. Neither contains Breaching Strike. No relevant real-player Arena exports or current Knight Campaign observations available; no simulations run.
basis: Requested promotion of one new common Strike: Breaching Strike Common -> Rare, Mana 1 -> 2, damage 7/10 -> 18/24, Exposed 1 -> 2. Both modes. Hand budget: 18 + 2×3 = 24 versus a 2-Mana Rare target of 19×1.25 = 23.75 points; upgrade 24 + 6 = 30. This is a heuristic, not measured parity. Raised Hell still auto-plays for no Mana. The 33 new arena paintings change presentation only.
target: Arena first: distinct competitive styles at1000HP; typical10+ own turns. Drago optimized-deck target roughly50% or somewhat above, pending representative human/deck evidence.

ratings.name: Paladin

arena.long: Not established beyond ten own turns

ratings.setup: One stronger Strike is optional. Two-Mana manual attacks compete with Aura setup; Raised Hell itself remains 2 Mana and requires later Strike draws. Rarity is not guaranteed acquisition.
ratings.recovery: Breaching Strike grants no Barrier, healing or draw. Spending 2 Mana instead of 1 can reduce defense that turn. Shield Strike retains 5/8 damage and 5/6 Barrier; unchanged recovery cards remain necessary.
ratings.rareReliance: Breaching Strike changes Common -> Rare. Raised Hell remains an optional Rare; together they raise acquisition dependence. Shield Strike remains Common and Muster Strike Uncommon; early builds still have lower-rarity support.
ratings.scaling: A larger fixed hit plus 2 Exposed improves attack follow-up when a target survives; Exposed is applied after this hit. Existing Might/Exposed multipliers and duration rules remain. Each copy counts once for Mastered Strike. Repeated free casts need draws and the Aura; no new self-draw or resource loop.
ratings.rationale: Breaching Strike is now Rare, 2 Mana, 18/24 damage then 2 Exposed. Manual play competes for an extra Mana; Raised Hell still bypasses that cost on draw. A narrower acquisition pool and stronger individual copy do not establish better whole-deck consistency.
ratings.watch: Separate manual play from Raised Hell auto-play, missing-Rare builds from completed recipes, opening/6–10/11+ own turns, Arena seats and human/ghost sources. Record Campaign I–III class starts and IV–VII/VIII–X/XI–XII positions. Preserve HP/Boons/difficulty/rules/AI separation.
ratings.confidence: Low; no relevant player observations of Breaching Strike or measured rules89 games.
ratings.pacing: No Arena HP, turn clock, damage rules, AI policy or Campaign enemy change. Ten-plus-own-turn pacing and approximately 50% optimized Drago clear remain targets, not results.
evidence: Historical client Campaign positions mvvj1kc7-6049 and mw2hdh90-7d18 contain no Breaching Strike; they cannot validate this revision.

corrections: Supersedes the 0.210 common/common/uncommon Strike package: now Common/Rare/Uncommon.
A higher rarity is not itself a power buff or evidence that players will choose the card. Increased hit/debuff values are offset by an additional manual Mana and reduced common-pool access.
Historical Campaign saves are client-observed positions, not independent matches or complete reward histories. They contain no tested card and support no promotion grade.
No class letter grades are changed. All thirty Ascendancies, class starts, free mixing and long-fight recovery remain unmeasured for this revision.
Arena 1000 HP per side and current enemy/Elite pressure are unchanged. No simulations authorized or performed.

mixedBuilds.name: Knight Strike/draw plus Barrier banking
mixedBuilds.assessment: Rare Breaching adds a strong free hit after Raised Hell setup but no draw or survival itself. Two-Mana manual casts compete with defense; preserve Common Shield and Uncommon Muster alternatives.

mixedBuilds.name: Foreign Strike package with native sustain or summons
mixedBuilds.assessment: Stronger per-copy damage and Exposed can aid follow-up attacks. Opportunity cost includes drawing and manually paying for a foreign Attack, acquiring optional Rares, and maintaining the native engine. No assumed reward offers or measured grade.
